headline: Eight appointments and reappointments approved, including three new firefighters.
summary: Cole Johnson, Chase Burgo, and Andrew St. Dennis will replace Deputy Chief Patrick J. Roy, firefighter Tim O'Kane, and firefighter Sam Garcia. The Cultural Council gained two new members. The Conservation Commission gained one new member and one reappointed member.
decisions: Approved the appointment of Stephanie Lee to the Cultural Council.
Approved the appointment of Kathleen Goss to the Cultural Council.
Approved the appointment of three permanent full-time firefighters.
Approved the appointment of Jeanne M. Hudson to the Conservation Commission.
Approved the reappointment of Michelle Marino as Veteran Service Commissioner.
Approved the reappointment of Sean Michael Tatnawat to the Conservation Commission.
discussion: Firefighter appointments: Members asked about department staffing. The fire chief said the ambulance contract requires staffing to stay at 81.
Veteran Service Commissioner reappointment: Members spoke in favor of the reappointment and described her work with veterans.
Conservation Commission nominee: Members noted Jeanne M. Hudson's past service as an associate member and on the Zoning Board.
